Game Overview

At its heart, Bee Jump is a tap game about guide a buzzing bee through ever-changing skies, tapping to dodge obstacles and collect honey jars. Enjoy a charming, shifting backdrop as you aim for high scores. With intuitive controls and delightful graphics, Bee Jump offers endless whimsical adventures in day or night. How sweet can your journey be?

Bee Jump keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide a buzzing bee through ever-changing skies, tapping to dodge obstacles and collect honey jars.
